::I agree that the Kin should be a different colour than novices. What colours were you thinking for the Asha'man and Forsaken--[[User:GuanYu79|GuanYu79]] 21:43, February 24, 2010 (UTC)

I think that the Forsaken can stay the same. The black/white combo works for them. A few of the Asha'man that I have looked at (the last time that I did) seem to take their nationality into consideration before their affiliation. This may or may not be the case. That would be somewhat easy to change, and I think that it should. The Asha'man are like the Aes Sedai (in a way) and when a woman is a Novice, Accepted or full Sister, their nationality doesn't dictate their tempalte color. I'm just not sure about colors at this point. A while back, when I changed the colors for the Unknown Ajah sisters, there wasn't many color combinations to be had (all eight Ajah colors, plus the Accepted "Orange" Ajah and the Novice "Purple" Ajah), so they got to be the Pink Ajah. If we are going the treat the Soldiers, Dedicated and full Asha'man the same, we would need three different color schemes or maybe a single first color and three different second colors. I just don't know right now. In the next week or so, I will be throwing some colors around. Let me know if you have any suggestions for anything. They would be greatly appreciated. Thanks! ----[[User:Mainphramephreak|<span style="color:#000099;"> '''Willie'''</span>]] - [[User Talk:Mainphramephreak|<span style="color:#990099;">'''''HtS'''''</span>]] 21:53, February 24, 2010 (UTC)

The Kandori flag is described as a "rearing red horse on a field of pale green." To me, and probably to the designer of the colors, it seems that red is the primary color with the green as the secondary. Either way, I propose a change to the green of Kandor to a paler green (seen above). It would make the colors different enough, in my opinion, to use the red and green for the Tinkers (#2).
